Bihar Police Seize $13,000 Worth of Contraband at Godda Border Crossing

On [date], Bihar police intercepted two smugglers from Bihar who were transporting contraband worth approximately $13,000 to Jharkhand. The smugglers were arrested during a vehicle checking operation. The seized contraband included cannabis valued at ₹50,000. Police claimed that the smugglers had been using this route to transport illicit goods into Jharkhand.
